A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a '''technician''' in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He served in a joint [[Darth Marr's task force|task force]] with [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]], and made a bet with a [[Unidentified female Imperial soldier (Darth Marr's flagship)|female]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] that a Republic individual would [[Death/Legends|kill]] an Imperial.

==Biography==
In [[3636 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4}}</ref> he was among the Imperial forces brought along by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Marr]] to serve in a joint [[Darth Marr's task force|task force]] with [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]], formed to search [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] for both the former [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and the [[Eternal Empire|mysterious force]] that had [[Eternal Empire raids|attacked]] several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. The [[Technician/Legends|technician]] served aboard [[Darth Marr's flagship]], and made a bet with a [[Unidentified female Imperial soldier (Darth Marr's flagship)|female]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] that someone would be [[Death/Legends|killed]] before the mission was over. As [[Alliance Commander|the individual]]<ref name="Chapter 1" /> who [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|defeated]] the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]] walked past them,<ref name="Confederacy">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Confederacy|Yavin 4}}</ref> he and the soldier argued. The soldier believed that since there had been no deaths, she had won the bet, to which the technician replied that the mission wasn't over yet and he was sure someone from the Republic would kill an Imperial. She pointed out that the Republic was outnumbered and had just as much reason to cooperate as the Empire did, but he dismissed her reasoning.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Personality and traits==
The technician had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and hair, and fair skin. He was very paranoid regarding the Republic forces aboard Marr's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], certain one of them would kill an Imperial.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The technician first appeared in the first chapter of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', a [[2015]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a massively-mulitplayer online game developed by [[BioWare]]. In the game, the soldier appears as a non-player character only identified as "Imperial Technician".<ref name="Chapter 1" />
